QuestInfo.0: The Fierce Beast captured a lot of the little Miwok Boys! Talk to the Chief, he may have some ideas on how to save them.
QuestInfo.1: Poor little Miwok Boys! They must be saved!
QuestInfo.2: The Chief has offered rewards for any Miwok Boys you can rescue. You will be rewarded based on how many times you participate in the rescue, so make sure to save them all!
QuestInfo.name: [Miwok Boy] Help rescue the Miwok Boys!

0.0: #b#h0##k, blessings of the jungle be upon you. The Fierce Beasts have taken the Miwok Boys of our tribe! Won't you help them?! They are so terribly helpless!

no.0: Oh, I understand. You have too much on your plate to help a few children in mortal peril.

yes.0:
I knew you'd help. #rYou can accept my quest from the Miwok Notifier every 30 minutes on the hour#k to get to #bSnakerot Jungle#k. We'll need all the help we can get!\r\n\r\n
When you're fighitng the beasts, you'll see Miwok Boys like this little fellow: #i2430513#. Hit the #rpick-up key (Z)#k to grab those boys! Your current count will be on the #bleft side of the screen#k.
yes.1:
Oh, and you might see #rRaging Beasts#k from time to time. 

#i3800248#
If you take the #b#i3994428# #t3994428##k away from a Raging Beast and #rdouble-click#k the Strong Cage, you can free a lot of the Miwok Boys at once. The #rShabby Cages#k, however, should break if you hit the #bregular attack key#k. Remember, you can rescue multiple Miwok Boys at once!
yes.2:
Fill up the #bMiwok Rescue Log, which is accessible from the Miwok Notifier#k. You'll receive rewards every time you complete #bLog Goals#k.\r\n\r\n

Save all the boys you can. #rThe rewards will be better for each boy you rescue#k.
